title: Utility Order for Jefferson Davis Electric Cooperative, Inc., ex parte. — Order No. U-37769 accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on June 24, 2026, in which the Parties agreed that: the Commission does not object to MISO considering the Facilities as transmission facilities in accordance with the FERC 7 factor test, that JDEC has not requested approval of the O&M agreement, JDEC does not seek approval of a sale or conveyance of the facilities, and the Parties agree that JDEC’s proposed transfer of functional control is in the public interest and subject to a series of contingencies for reopening the docket. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.
